title: Salt and Choir
author: Hazel Okonkwo
blurb: Zephyrine Villalobos, a bone-carver who hears the dead, has spent seven years selling small charms in a city that outlawed magic. Then tonight's date appears in a book of prophecies written a century ago — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must reforge a broken covenant between realms, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
